017package org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728;
018
019import org.apache.juneau.commons.bean.*;
020
021/**
022 * CRTP base for every successful MCP {@code 2026-07-28} result, carrying the required {@code resultType}
023 * discriminator and optional {@link ResultMeta} under the reserved {@code _meta} wire key.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * The {@code 2026-07-28} schema declares {@code resultType} as an open string union: {@code "complete"} and
027 * {@code "input_required"} ({@link InputRequiredResult}, MRTR / SEP-2322) are the values this bean model
028 * permits. Only {@code "complete"} is emitted by any dispatch path today; {@code "input_required"} becomes
029 * reachable once MRTR pause/resume dispatch wiring is in place. Parsing remains lossless regardless and
030 * accepts any string a peer might send. The field therefore defaults to {@code "complete"} rather than being
031 * validated against a closed enumeration.
032 *
033 * <p>
034 * {@link CacheableResult} extends this base so the five cacheable list/read results inherit {@code resultType}
035 * and {@code _meta} alongside their cache hints. Every other concrete result bean ({@link CallToolResult},
036 * {@link GetPromptResult}, {@link CompleteResult}, and {@link PingResult}) extends this base directly.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * The CRTP type parameter lets each concrete subclass's fluent setters return its own concrete type for method
040 * chaining, without duplicating the {@code resultType} / {@code _meta} accessors in every subclass.
041 *
042 * @param <T> The concrete subclass, for fluent-setter self-typing.
043 */
044public abstract class Result<T extends Result<T>> {
045
046   private String resultType = "complete";
047   private ResultMeta meta;
048
049   /**
050    * Result-type discriminator.
051    *
052    * <p>
053    * Defaults to {@code "complete"}. The schema defines this as an open string union, so parsing accepts any
054    * string losslessly.
055    *
056    * @return The result type. Never <jk>null</jk> on a server-constructed instance.
057    */
058   public String getResultType() {
059      return resultType;
060   }
061
062   /**
063    * Sets the result-type discriminator.
064    *
065    * @param value The new value.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the property.
066    * @return This object (for method chaining).
067    */
068   @SuppressWarnings({
069      "unchecked" // CRTP subclasses bind T to their own concrete type.
070   })
071   public T setResultType(String value) {
072      resultType = value;
073      return (T)this;
074   }
075
076   /**
077    * Result metadata: server identity plus any echoed trace context.
078    *
079    * @return The metadata, or {@code null} if not set.
080    */
081   @BeanProp("_meta")
082   public ResultMeta getMeta() {
083      return meta;
084   }
085
086   /**
087    * Sets the result metadata.
088    *
089    * @param value The new value.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the property.
090    * @return This object (for method chaining).
091    */
092   @BeanProp("_meta")
093   @SuppressWarnings({
094      "unchecked" // CRTP subclasses bind T to their own concrete type.
095   })
096   public T setMeta(ResultMeta value) {
097      meta = value;
098      return (T)this;
099   }
100}
